units.source_text: “爸爸，不是好不好的问题，您还记得吗，

en.t: "Father, it is not a question of whether he is good or not. Do you remember,

units.source_text: 您在植物园问过我，让秀男做我的终身伴侣怎么样，

en.t: at the botanical garden you asked me what I thought about making Hideo my lifelong companion,

units.source_text: 这事，那位姑娘全都知道了。”

en.t: and that young woman knows all about it now."
